question: Pick 3 cards with rarity of uncommon, list down name these cards according to ascending order of it's ruling date.
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.rarity = 'uncommon' ORDER BY T2.date ASC LIMIT 3
gold0: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.rarity = 'uncommon' ORDER BY T2.date ASC LIMIT 3

c.sql: SELECT c.name FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.rarity = 'uncommon' ORDER BY r.date ASC LIMIT 3

b.request: Select any 3 cards with rarity 'uncommon' (including cards that have no matching rulings record, via a left join from cards to rulings) and list their names ordered by ruling date ascending
b.sql: SELECT c.name FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.rarity = 'uncommon' ORDER BY r.date ASC LIMIT 3
